sec06-card-sec06-F30.expected_back: Check behind the vehicle before you get in, because children and small objects cannot be seen from the driver's seat.

sec06-card-sec06-F31.front: Once seated, what three actions with brake, gearshift, and left hand begin backing up?
sec06-card-sec06-F31.expected_back: To back up, keep your foot on the brake, shift into reverse and take hold of the wheel at twelve o'clock with your left hand.

sec06-card-sec06-F32.front: Where does your right arm go and where do your eyes look while reversing?
sec06-card-sec06-F32.memory_hook: Right arm across, look out back
sec06-card-sec06-F32.expected_back: Rest your right arm on the back of the passenger seat and look straight out through the rear window.

sec06-card-sec06-F33.front: How should you use mirrors and a backup camera while reversing, and what zone do mirrors miss?
sec06-card-sec06-F33.memory_hook: Glance briefly, mirrors miss directly behind
sec06-card-sec06-F33.expected_back: Glance at your mirrors from time to time while backing, knowing they do not show the area right behind the vehicle, and check a rearview camera now and then if you have one.

sec06-card-sec06-R09.front: While backing up, what gives your main view and what role do mirrors and cameras play?
sec06-card-sec06-R09.expected_back: When reversing, your main view comes from turning to look through the rear window, while mirrors and a camera are only checked now and then.

sec06-card-sec06-F34.front: How should you control speed in reverse, and why is creeping slowly essential?
sec06-card-sec06-F34.expected_back: Accelerate gently and keep your speed low in reverse, because a vehicle is much harder to steer when backing.

sec06-card-sec06-F35.front: How much and in which direction should you steer when guiding a backing vehicle?
sec06-card-sec06-F35.expected_back: While backing, steer a little toward the side you want the rear of the vehicle to move.

sec06-card-sec06-F36.front: When turning while backing up, where else must you glance quickly besides straight back?
sec06-card-sec06-F36.expected_back: If you are turning while you back up, make quick checks to the front and both sides.

sec06-card-sec06-F37.front: How long must you keep looking backward when finishing a reverse maneuver?
sec06-card-sec06-F37.expected_back: Keep looking toward the rear until the vehicle comes to a complete stop.

sec06-card-sec06-R10.front: What steering habit and visual habit stay consistent all the way through backing up?
sec06-card-sec06-R10.memory_hook: Slight steering, eyes back until stopped
sec06-card-sec06-R10.expected_back: When backing you steer slightly toward where the rear should go, and your rearward look continues until the vehicle has fully stopped.

sec02-card-sec02-F01.question_text: Which two additional turnabouts and what high-speed roadway type can also appear on the skills test?
sec02-card-sec02-F01.teaching_text: Practicing highway merges and tight three-point turnarounds keeps you ready if the route includes them.

sec02-card-sec02-F02.question_text: How long must any applicant wait to retest after failing the skills exam on attempt one?
sec02-card-sec02-F02.teaching_text: Weekends and state holidays do not count toward those two business days regardless of your age.

sec02-card-sec02-F03.question_text: How many calendar days must you wait after a second failed skills test versus a third or subsequent failure?
sec02-card-sec02-F03.teaching_text: Missing attempt three locks you out for a full thirty calendar days to build real behind-the-wheel polish.

sec02-card-sec02-R01.question_text: How does the day-counting method shift between a first skills-test failure and later failures?
sec02-card-sec02-R01.teaching_text: Exam questions test whether you spot business days on fail one versus straight calendar days on fails two and three.

sec02-card-sec02-F04.question_text: Within how many days must a new permanent resident switch an out-of-state license or ID, and who is exempt?
sec02-card-sec02-F04.teaching_text: South Carolina gives forty-five days rather than thirty, while excusing active-duty military and U.S. Government employees.

sec02-card-sec02-R03.question_text: Which two federal-service groups do not face South Carolina's forty-five-day new-resident switch deadline?
sec02-card-sec02-R03.teaching_text: Keep both active-duty service members and U.S. Government workers paired together on residency questions.

sec02-card-sec02-F05.question_text: What happens to your old out-of-state card when switching to SC, and what expiration length triggers all three exams?
sec02-card-sec02-F05.teaching_text: Letting a former state's license sit expired past nine months puts vision, knowledge, and skills tests back on your plate.
sec02-card-sec02-F05.must_match_memory_hook: Surrender card; over nine months retests

visual_sync.text_span: Surrender card; over nine months retests

sec02-card-sec02-R02.question_text: Contrast the licensing rule for someone moving permanently to South Carolina against a temporary out-of-state student?
sec02-card-sec02-R02.teaching_text: College students here temporarily drive legally on valid home-state cards while permanent movers switch within forty-five days.

sec02-card-sec02-F06.question_text: What credential must temporary residents like military members, students, and their dependents hold to drive in SC?
sec02-card-sec02-F06.teaching_text: Exemption from switching never allows driving on an expired card; your home-state license must stay valid.

sec02-card-sec02-F07.question_text: What chain of events cancels your South Carolina license or ID when you move and get licensed in a new state?
sec02-card-sec02-F07.teaching_text: Handing your SC card to the new state's DMV triggers state-to-state notice that cancels your old SC credential.

sec02-card-sec02-F08.question_text: After registering your car in a new state, why must you return your SC license plate before dropping SC insurance?
sec02-card-sec02-F08.teaching_text: Canceling SC insurance while SCDMV still shows an active plate can slap you with up to four hundred dollars in fees.

sec02-card-sec02-F09.question_text: What allows a permanent resident of another U.S. state to drive legally while visiting South Carolina?
sec02-card-sec02-F09.teaching_text: Tourists and business travelers never need a South Carolina credential while holding a valid license from home.

sec02-card-sec02-R04.question_text: Why can someone living permanently in New York drive in South Carolina without worrying about the forty-five-day switch?
sec02-card-sec02-R04.teaching_text: Residency—not crossing the state line—is what starts the forty-five-day South Carolina licensing clock.

sec02-card-sec02-F10.question_text: What does an International Driving Permit actually do for visitors from non-English-speaking countries, and what is it not?
sec02-card-sec02-F10.teaching_text: Carrying only an International Driving Permit without the underlying foreign license leaves a visitor unlicensed.

sec02-card-sec02-R05.question_text: What must always accompany an International Driving Permit during a traffic stop?
sec02-card-sec02-R05.teaching_text: Officers read the English translation booklet alongside your active home-country plastic card.

sec02-card-sec02-F11.question_text: When does South Carolina waive knowledge and skills tests for a first-time applicant holding a foreign license?
sec02-card-sec02-F11.teaching_text: Countries with formal South Carolina reciprocity let eligible holders skip straight past written and road testing.

sec02-card-sec02-F12.question_text: Past what expiration length does a reciprocity-country license lose its South Carolina test waiver?
sec02-card-sec02-F12.teaching_text: Notice nine months matches the exact same expiration cliff applied to out-of-state and South Carolina renewals.

sec02-card-sec02-F13.question_text: What screening is required to renew a South Carolina license, and what does a branch charge for it?
sec02-card-sec02-F13.teaching_text: Every South Carolina DMV branch office runs renewal vision screenings at zero extra charge.

sec02-card-sec02-F14.question_text: How fresh must a Certificate of Vision Examination be to replace branch screening, and how do SC doctors submit it?
sec02-card-sec02-F14.teaching_text: An eye exam from up to three years back still counts when filed through SCDMV's online portal.

sec02-card-sec02-R06.question_text: Contrast the thirty-six-month window on a vision certificate with the date limit on a military Leave and Earning Statement?
sec02-card-sec02-R06.teaching_text: Eye exams stay good for three years, whereas military pay statements must be dated within thirty-one days.
sec02-card-sec02-R06.must_match_memory_hook: Thirty-six months eyes, thirty-one days military

visual_sync.text_span: Thirty-six months eyes, thirty-one days military

sec02-card-sec02-F15.question_text: Which two documents let active-duty military members skip vision screening during license renewal?
sec02-card-sec02-F15.teaching_text: Pairing a recent Leave and Earning Statement with an unexpired military ID waives the renewal eye check.

sec02-card-sec02-R07.question_text: How do active-duty service members renewing online or by mail submit their LES and military ID?
sec02-card-sec02-R07.teaching_text: Stationed troops away from South Carolina simply mail or email copies of both military documents.

sec02-card-sec02-F25.question_text: Which SCDMV form does an eye-care professional licensed outside South Carolina complete for a vision certificate?
sec02-card-sec02-F25.teaching_text: Doctors outside SC lack portal access, so they record your exam on Form 412-NC instead.

sec02-card-sec02-F16.question_text: Who is allowed to renew a South Carolina license online, and how many years does the renewed card run?
sec02-card-sec02-F16.teaching_text: Eligible citizens renewing online secure a full eight-year South Carolina license cycle right from home.

sec02-card-sec02-F17.question_text: Which license classes qualify for online renewal, which license type is barred, and what expiry limit applies?
sec02-card-sec02-F17.teaching_text: Commercial CDL holders and anyone expired past nine months must skip online renewal.
sec02-card-sec02-F17.must_match_memory_hook: Regular classes, no CDL, nine months

visual_sync.text_span: Regular classes, no CDL, nine months

sec02-card-sec02-F18.question_text: What federal record match and two-year point cap must you satisfy to renew online?
sec02-card-sec02-F18.teaching_text: A name mismatch with Social Security or six points in two years sends your renewal to a branch.
sec02-card-sec02-F18.must_match_memory_hook: Matching SSA data, max five points

visual_sync.text_span: Matching SSA data, max five points

sec02-card-sec02-R08.question_text: How many points accumulated over the past two years disqualify you from renewing online?
sec02-card-sec02-R08.teaching_text: Five points still clears the online gate, whereas six or more over two years shuts it.

sec02-card-sec02-F19.question_text: Which four suspension, prior-renewal, criminal-registry, or teen-license statuses block online renewal?
sec02-card-sec02-F19.teaching_text: Conditional and special restricted teen holders, suspended drivers, violent offenders, and last-cycle remote renewers cannot renew online.

sec02-card-sec02-R09.question_text: Why can't you renew online if your previous renewal was done by mail or online?
sec02-card-sec02-R09.teaching_text: SCDMV requires an in-person cycle in between so photos and records do not go sixteen years untouched.

sec02-card-sec02-F20.question_text: During an online renewal, how do your vision certificate and payment reach the SCDMV?
sec02-card-sec02-F20.teaching_text: Your South Carolina eye doctor transmits vision clearance digitally before you pay by credit card.

sec02-card-sec02-F21.question_text: Whose photo and signature print on an online-renewed license, and how soon does it arrive in the mail?
sec02-card-sec02-F21.teaching_text: Keeping your existing photo and signature lets SCDMV mail the new card within seven to ten business days.

sec02-card-sec02-F22.question_text: Which form, vision proof, and twenty-five-dollar payment types belong in a mail-renewal envelope—and what payment is banned?
sec02-card-sec02-F22.teaching_text: Slipping twenty-five dollars cash into the envelope breaks SCDMV rules; send a check or money order.

sec02-card-sec02-R10.question_text: On a mail renewal, how does proving an SC eye doctor's exam differ from proving an out-of-state eye exam?
sec02-card-sec02-R10.teaching_text: In-state doctors already logged your exam online, so their receipt number suffices while outside doctors enclose paper.

sec02-card-sec02-F23.question_text: At least how far ahead of expiration should you drop a mail renewal in the post, and what image prints on it?
sec02-card-sec02-F23.teaching_text: Mailing three weeks early keeps your current card valid while postal transit and processing reuse your existing photo.

sec02-card-sec02-F24.question_text: Which three items—covering eyesight, vehicle coverage, and payment—do you need for an in-person branch renewal?
sec02-card-sec02-F24.teaching_text: Knowing the name of your auto insurance company before reaching the counter prevents holding up your renewal.

sec02-card-sec02-F26.question_text: May you drive while expired, and what testing applies at a branch if your license expired nine months ago or less?
sec02-card-sec02-F26.teaching_text: Get a ride to the branch within nine months and you renew without retaking knowledge or skills exams.
sec02-card-sec02-F26.must_match_memory_hook: Never drive; nine months skips tests

visual_sync.text_span: Never drive; nine months skips tests

sec02-card-sec02-R11.question_text: What flips at the nine-month mark after a South Carolina driver's license expires?
sec02-card-sec02-R11.teaching_text: Month nine renews test-free at a branch, whereas month ten sends you back through vision, knowledge, and skills.
sec02-card-sec02-R11.must_match_memory_hook: Past nine months triggers all tests

visual_sync.text_span: Past nine months triggers all tests

sec02-card-sec02-F27.question_text: Beyond retaking vision, knowledge, and skills tests, what paperwork must you bring for a license expired over nine months?
sec02-card-sec02-F27.teaching_text: Long-expired renewals happen in person with fresh address proof plus any identity papers not yet on file.

sec02-card-sec02-F28.question_text: Which three courts or jurisdictions can add violation points onto your South Carolina driving record?
sec02-card-sec02-F28.teaching_text: Getting a speeding ticket on vacation out of state or on a military base still posts points back home.

sec02-card-sec02-R12.question_text: Does paying a traffic ticket in another state keep points off your South Carolina record?
sec02-card-sec02-R12.teaching_text: States share conviction data electronically, so out-of-state moving violations land right on your SC point total.

sec02-card-sec02-F29.question_text: How do violation points age one year after the ticket's violation date?
sec02-card-sec02-F29.teaching_text: Note the one-year clock runs from the violation date on the ticket rather than the court date.
sec02-card-sec02-F29.must_match_memory_hook: Cut in half after one year

visual_sync.text_span: Cut in half after one year

sec02-card-sec02-F30.question_text: At which two low point totals does SCDMV mail warning letters to fifteen- and sixteen-year-old drivers?
sec02-card-sec02-F30.teaching_text: Young teens get early nudges at two and four points before hitting the six-point suspension line.

sec02-card-sec02-F31.question_text: At what point counts do drivers aged seventeen or older receive a warning letter versus a license suspension?
sec02-card-sec02-F31.teaching_text: Drivers aged seventeen and older receive their warning letter halfway to the twelve-point suspension ceiling.

sec02-card-sec02-F32.question_text: What happens when a permit, conditional, or special restricted holder hits six points, and can defensive driving undo it?
sec02-card-sec02-F32.teaching_text: Once an excessive-points teen suspension triggers at six points, taking a defensive driving class cannot lift it.
sec02-card-sec02-F32.must_match_memory_hook: Suspended at six, course won't reinstate

visual_sync.text_span: Suspended at six, course won't reinstate

sec02-card-sec02-R13.question_text: Compare the point suspension threshold for teen permit, conditional, and restricted holders against drivers seventeen-plus?
sec02-card-sec02-R13.teaching_text: Graduated credentials allow only half the point cushion that standard seventeen-plus licenses carry.

sec02-card-sec02-R14.question_text: Do points used in an excessive-points teen suspension vanish, or can they still count toward regular point suspension?
sec02-card-sec02-R14.teaching_text: Serving an excessive-points suspension does not wipe those underlying points off the regular twelve-point ledger.

sec02-card-sec02-F33.question_text: How do violations like driving under the influence suspend your license without relying on the point system?
sec02-card-sec02-F33.teaching_text: Zero prior points will not keep you driving after an offense that carries its own statutory suspension.

sec02-card-sec02-F34.question_text: Which course cuts points off a South Carolina record, and what format and location rules apply?
sec02-card-sec02-F34.teaching_text: Online traffic-school websites do not count; the National Safety Council or equivalent class must happen in person in SC.

sec02-card-sec02-R15.question_text: Which driving schools are authorized to teach South Carolina's point-reduction defensive driving course?
sec02-card-sec02-R15.teaching_text: Always verify that a driving school holds specific SCDMV four-point-reduction certification before paying any tuition.

sec02-card-sec02-F35.question_text: How many classroom hours is the point-reduction course, when must you take it, and how often can you use it?
sec02-card-sec02-F35.teaching_text: Taking a class before a ticket cannot bank credit ahead, and you get only one reduction every three years.

sec02-card-sec02-F36.question_text: Why must you finish a point-reduction course before a pending point suspension takes effect?
sec02-card-sec02-F36.teaching_text: Once a suspension has already kicked in, shaving four points off your record will not cancel it.

sec02-card-sec02-F37.question_text: What two payment options exist for drivers who owe reinstatement fees on a South Carolina license?
sec02-card-sec02-F37.teaching_text: Drivers owing at least the qualifying threshold can spread reinstatement fees out by following plan rules.

sec02-card-sec02-R16.question_text: Because suspension rules vary widely, through which three channels should you check your exact reinstatement steps?
sec02-card-sec02-R16.teaching_text: Checking directly with SCDMV online, by phone, or in person prevents guessing wrong on your specific suspension.

sec02-card-sec02-F38.question_text: What duration, fee, and program enrollment attach to a provisional license after an eligible first DUI or DUAC?
sec02-card-sec02-F38.teaching_text: Enrolling in the Alcohol and Drug Safety Action Program and paying one hundred dollars backs that six-month card.

sec02-card-sec02-F39.question_text: For offenses from October one, two thousand fourteen onward, what maximum BAC allowed provisional-license eligibility?
sec02-card-sec02-F39.teaching_text: Blowing point one five or higher pushed the offense above the provisional BAC ceiling.

sec02-card-sec02-F40.question_text: How did May nineteen, two thousand twenty-four change provisional licenses for DUI or DUAC offenses?
sec02-card-sec02-F40.teaching_text: South Carolina lawmakers closed the provisional-license door for DUI and DUAC stops beginning in mid-May twenty twenty-four.

sec02-card-sec02-R17.question_text: Can a provisional license cover a repeat DUI, or unrelated extra suspensions?
sec02-card-sec02-R17.teaching_text: Only a first DUI or DUAC—and suspensions stemming from that exact same stop—could ever ride under a provisional.

sec02-card-sec02-R18.question_text: What prior South Carolina license status and sanction history are required before getting a provisional license?
sec02-card-sec02-R18.teaching_text: Any unresolved prior suspensions, revocations, or cancellations on your record block provisional eligibility until cleared.

sec02-card-sec02-F41.question_text: Which immigration status is required for a non-U.S. citizen to obtain a route-restricted license?
sec02-card-sec02-F41.teaching_text: Temporary visa holders do not qualify; non-citizens must hold permanent resident alien status.

sec02-card-sec02-F42.question_text: Where may a route-restricted driver travel non-commercially, and what document must stay in the car?
sec02-card-sec02-F42.teaching_text: Detouring to a grocery store or forgetting the approved route sheet in the car violates your restriction.

sec02-card-sec02-F43.question_text: How long does a route-restricted license run, what does it cost, and how often is it usually granted?
sec02-card-sec02-F43.teaching_text: For most listed suspensions you get just one route-restricted chance in your entire life.

sec02-card-sec02-F44.question_text: Which two suspension types are exceptions that may allow more than one route-restricted license?
sec02-card-sec02-F44.teaching_text: Unpaid child support and a first or second driving-under-suspension within five years are not capped at once per lifetime.

sec02-card-sec02-R19.question_text: Which eight serious suspension categories strictly limit you to one route-restricted license per lifetime?
sec02-card-sec02-R19.teaching_text: Alcohol, point one five BAC, drugs, implied consent, blue-light flight, crash judgments, and ID or insurance fraud get one shot ever.

sec02-card-sec02-R20.question_text: Which SCDMV form applies for a route-restricted license, and where do you mail it?
sec02-card-sec02-R20.teaching_text: Route-restricted applications go by mail on Form DL-127 directly to SCDMV Driver Records.

sec02-card-sec02-F45.question_text: What fee and thirty-day filing unlock a Temporary Alcohol License, and which four alcohol suspensions qualify?
sec02-card-sec02-F45.teaching_text: Filing for an administrative hearing within thirty days lets adult or under-twenty-one implied-consent or BAC suspendees seek this temporary card.

sec02-card-sec02-F46.question_text: When does a Temporary Alcohol License stop working, and what must happen to the card regardless of the ruling?
sec02-card-sec02-F46.teaching_text: Win or lose at the hearing, the temporary plastic expires once results hit SCDMV and must be turned back in.

sec02-card-sec02-R21.question_text: If the hearing officer overturns your suspension completely, do you still have to return the Temporary Alcohol License?
sec02-card-sec02-R21.teaching_text: Even after winning your hearing, SCDMV holds back your regular license until you hand back the temporary card.

sec03-card-sec03-F01.question_text: Does the handbook's state-laws chapter claim to list every single South Carolina law?
sec03-card-sec03-F01.teaching_text: Knowing a rule is absent from this brief chapter never excuses breaking another statute in state code.

sec03-card-sec03-F02.question_text: Which applicants must fill out Form 447-SEL for Selective Service when getting a permit, license, or ID?
sec03-card-sec03-F02.teaching_text: Both male U.S. citizens and male immigrants younger than twenty-six fill out the supplement across all three cards.

sec03-card-sec03-R02.question_text: Does the Selective Service supplement apply only to driver's licenses, or to permits and ID cards too?
sec03-card-sec03-R02.teaching_text: Applying for a non-driving state ID card triggers the exact same Selective Service paperwork as a permit or license.

sec03-card-sec03-F03.question_text: At what birthday does SCDMV transmit Selective Service details, and which six pieces of data get sent?
sec03-card-sec03-F03.teaching_text: SCDMV holds a teen's data until birthday eighteen, then forwards name, address, birth date, sex, SSN, and application date.
sec03-card-sec03-F03.must_match_memory_hook: Sent at eighteen with six details

visual_sync.text_span: Sent at eighteen with six details

sec03-card-sec03-R01.question_text: Separate the age ceiling for filling out Form 447-SEL from the birthday when SCDMV transmits the data?
sec03-card-sec03-R01.teaching_text: A fifteen-year-old fills out Form 447-SEL at permit time, yet federal transmission waits until he turns eighteen.

sec03-card-sec03-F04.question_text: What action before turning eighteen stops SCDMV from sending your data to Selective Service?
sec03-card-sec03-F04.teaching_text: Merely letting a permit sit in a drawer does nothing; physically turning the credential back in before eighteen halts transfer.

sec03-card-sec03-F05.question_text: During which SCDMV transactions and on which three credentials can you register as an organ and tissue donor?
sec03-card-sec03-F05.teaching_text: Permits, licenses, and ID cards all offer donor registration both when first applying and at renewal.

sec03-card-sec03-F06.question_text: What two things happen to your state record and plastic card when you register as a donor at SCDMV?
sec03-card-sec03-F06.teaching_text: Your identity goes onto the South Carolina Donor Registry while a red heart symbol prints on your card.

sec03-card-sec03-F07.question_text: Under South Carolina's Uniform Anatomical Gift Act, what legal standing does donor registration carry?
sec03-card-sec03-F07.teaching_text: Checking yes is an enforceable anatomical gift under state law rather than an informal wish.

sec03-card-sec03-F08.question_text: If someone registers as an organ donor before turning eighteen, who holds the final say on donation?
sec03-card-sec03-F08.teaching_text: Until adulthood at eighteen, a parent or legal guardian makes the final donation call.
sec03-card-sec03-F08.must_match_memory_hook: Parent or guardian decides under eighteen

visual_sync.text_span: Parent or guardian decides under eighteen

sec03-card-sec03-R03.question_text: Reconcile donor registration being legally binding with how South Carolina treats registrants younger than eighteen?
sec03-card-sec03-R03.teaching_text: Adults make their own binding choice, whereas minor registrations still leave final authority with parents or guardians.

sec03-card-sec03-F09.question_text: Where do you go to update or change your South Carolina organ donor decision?
sec03-card-sec03-F09.teaching_text: You can adjust your donor preferences online anytime through the Donate Life South Carolina portal.

sec03-card-sec03-F10.question_text: What two immediate legal consequences can hit someone caught tossing trash along South Carolina streets or highways?
sec03-card-sec03-F10.teaching_text: Tossing fast-food bags out a window is an arrestable offense carrying real fines, not just a warning.

sec03-card-sec03-F11.question_text: Along with a fine, what hands-on penalty can a judge order for a highway littering offender?
sec03-card-sec03-F11.teaching_text: Judges regularly pair financial fines with hours picking up roadside trash under court supervision.

sec03-card-sec03-R04.question_text: Does supervised roadside trash pickup replace a littering fine or stack right on top of it?
sec03-card-sec03-R04.teaching_text: Expect both wallet pain and roadside cleanup duty together when convicted of littering.

sec03-card-sec03-F12.question_text: How does South Carolina litter law classify cigarettes and cigarette butts, and how should drivers handle them?
sec03-card-sec03-F12.teaching_text: Flicking a tiny filter out the window sparks brush fires and carries the exact same littering status as trash bags.

sec03-card-sec03-F13.question_text: What everyday cabin item does the manual recommend keeping in your car to prevent littering?
sec03-card-sec03-F13.teaching_text: Stashing a small trash bag in the cabin stops loose wrappers from blowing out an open window.

sec03-card-sec03-R05.question_text: Which three everyday items does the handbook specifically name for your in-car litter container?
sec03-card-sec03-R05.teaching_text: Drive-thru cups, snack wrappers, and drink bottles make up classic roadside clutter unless bagged inside.

sec03-card-sec03-F14.question_text: What minimum age and credential must a golf-cart driver have, and what must the cart display?
sec03-card-sec03-F14.teaching_text: Letting an unlicensed teen or younger kid pilot the neighborhood golf cart breaks state law.

sec03-card-sec03-R06.question_text: Can an unlicensed sixteen-year-old or beginner's-permit teen legally drive a golf cart on public streets?
sec03-card-sec03-R06.teaching_text: Turning sixteen without holding an actual valid driver's license falls short of South Carolina's golf-cart rule.

sec03-card-sec03-F15.question_text: When may a registered golf cart operate, and how far from its registered address may it travel?
sec03-card-sec03-F15.teaching_text: Golf carts lack full highway crash gear and night lighting rules, capping trips to daylight within four miles.

sec03-card-sec03-R07.question_text: Besides the address on the registration certificate, what alternate starting point can measure the four-mile golf-cart radius?
sec03-card-sec03-R07.teaching_text: Large gated neighborhoods measure four daytime miles outward from the community's gate as well.

sec03-card-sec03-F16.question_text: What road type and maximum posted speed limit govern daytime golf-cart trips within four miles?
sec03-card-sec03-F16.teaching_text: Primary highways and faster streets stay off-limits because golf carts lack highway-speed crash protection.

sec03-card-sec03-R08.question_text: Is a golf cart allowed to travel down a road posted at forty miles per hour if it stays within one mile of home?
sec03-card-sec03-R08.teaching_text: Even right outside your driveway, any street posted above thirty-five miles per hour bars golf carts.

sec03-card-sec03-F17.question_text: Which separate SCDMV publication covers rules for commercial motor vehicles?
sec03-card-sec03-F17.teaching_text: Air-brake, hazmat, and heavy-truck rules live in SCDMV's dedicated Commercial Driver's License Manual.

sec03-card-sec03-F18.question_text: Which two separate SCDMV manuals cover two-wheelers versus heavy RVs and large non-commercial trucks?
sec03-card-sec03-F18.teaching_text: Two-wheel riders study the Motorcycle and Moped manual, while Class E and F RV drivers use the Large Non-Commercial manual.

sec03-card-sec03-R09.question_text: How does SCDMV pair mopeds, motorcycles, recreational vehicles, and large non-commercial trucks across its specialty manuals?
sec03-card-sec03-R09.teaching_text: Keep mopeds grouped with motorcycles in one book and motor homes grouped with large non-commercial rigs in the other.
sec03-card-sec03-R09.must_match_memory_hook: Mopeds with motorcycles, RVs with heavies

visual_sync.text_span: Mopeds with motorcycles, RVs with heavies

sec05-card-sec05-F01.question_text: While traffic and road surfaces stay beyond your control, what safety factor rests squarely in your hands?
sec05-card-sec05-F01.teaching_text: You cannot pick the weather or nearby motorists, so keeping your own ride and rubber road-ready protects every trip.

sec05-card-sec05-F02.question_text: Why are tire-related crashes avoidable, and which three tire conditions create safety hazards?
sec05-card-sec05-F02.teaching_text: Under-inflation, over-inflation, and worn grooves all ruin traction and braking long before a blowout happens.

sec05-card-sec05-F03.question_text: How often should you measure tire pressure, and what tool should you buy if you lack one?
sec05-card-sec05-F03.teaching_text: Eyeballing a radial tire hides slow air leaks, whereas a quick monthly gauge check catches pressure drops early.

sec05-card-sec05-F06.question_text: How do you use a gauge on the valve stem, and when should you measure tire pressure?
sec05-card-sec05-F06.teaching_text: Driving heats trapped air and inflates readings artificially, so measuring cold tires gives an accurate baseline.

sec05-card-sec05-R01.question_text: What do you adjust when your tire gauge reads higher or lower than the doorframe number?
sec05-card-sec05-R01.teaching_text: Bleeding excess air or adding missing air until the gauge matches the doorframe sticker keeps tire contact balanced.

sec05-card-sec05-F07.question_text: Which way do you hold and insert a coin when running the penny tread check, and into which groove?
sec05-card-sec05-F07.teaching_text: Flipping the coin upside down puts Lincoln's head at the exact depth benchmark needed to judge remaining rubber.

sec05-card-sec05-F08.question_text: What does seeing all of Lincoln's head in the tread groove tell you to do right away?
sec05-card-sec05-F08.teaching_text: Shallow grooves cannot channel rain out from under the rubber, inviting hydroplaning if you keep driving on them.

sec05-card-sec05-F09.question_text: How should your back and feet sit in the driver's seat, and why should you avoid slouching?
sec05-card-sec05-F09.teaching_text: Slouching lets your body submarine or twist during impact so belts and air bags cannot catch you cleanly.

sec05-card-sec05-F10.question_text: Why must you set your seat and mirrors before moving, and what three advantages does that setup give?
sec05-card-sec05-F10.teaching_text: Reaching for seat levers in traffic steals steering control while proper spacing keeps visibility, pedals, and air bags working.

sec05-card-sec05-F11.question_text: When your seat distance is dialed in, how should your foot and heel move between brake and gas?
sec05-card-sec05-F11.teaching_text: Lifting your whole foot between pedals wastes precious split seconds and risks catching the edge of the brake.

sec05-card-sec05-F12.question_text: How high may the top rim of the steering wheel sit relative to your body?
sec05-card-sec05-F12.teaching_text: Tilting the wheel above shoulder height blocks your forward sightline and tires your arms during turns.

sec05-card-sec05-F13.question_text: What minimum chest-to-wheel gap should you keep, and what seat mistakes must you avoid?
sec05-card-sec05-F13.teaching_text: Crowding the steering hub puts your chest inside the rapid inflation zone while reclining ruins seatbelt geometry.

sec05-card-sec05-F14.question_text: What injury do head restraints prevent, and where should yours touch instead of sitting low?
sec05-card-sec05-F14.teaching_text: A restraint dropped below ear level acts like a pivot point in a rear-end hit instead of catching your skull.

sec05-card-sec05-R05.question_text: How does the adjustment benchmark for your steering wheel differ from the benchmark for your head restraint?
sec05-card-sec05-R05.teaching_text: Keeping those two body landmarks straight stops permit prompts from swapping shoulder height with ear-level head contact.

sec05-card-sec05-F15.question_text: Which mirror serves as your main tool for checking traffic directly behind your vehicle?
sec05-card-sec05-F15.teaching_text: Your center windshield mirror gives the truest distance view directly aft before you ever change speed or lanes.

sec05-card-sec05-F16.question_text: What two visibility goals are your outside side mirrors adjusted to accomplish?
sec05-card-sec05-F16.teaching_text: Aiming side glass outward instead of staring at your own doors uncovers adjacent lanes where passing cars hide.

sec05-card-sec05-F17.question_text: Where do you position your head and aim the glass for the enhanced left outside mirror setting?
sec05-card-sec05-F17.teaching_text: Pushing the left glass outward from that leaned position sweeps away the classic lane-change blind pocket.

sec05-card-sec05-R04.question_text: How does your head lean differ when setting the enhanced right outside mirror compared to the left?
sec05-card-sec05-R04.teaching_text: Leaning toward the center console sets the passenger-side angle wide without leaving a gap beside your right quarter panel.

sec05-card-sec05-F18.question_text: What disappears from normal glances with enhanced side mirrors, and how many degrees of view do you gain?
sec05-card-sec05-F18.teaching_text: Trading away a redundant view of your own paint adds twelve to sixteen degrees of lane awareness per side.

sec05-card-sec05-F19.question_text: Who inside your vehicle must wear a safety belt or ride in a child restraint on every drive?
sec05-card-sec05-F19.teaching_text: One unbuckled rider becomes a heavy human projectile inside the cabin during a sudden rollover or side impact.

sec05-card-sec05-F20.question_text: What three crash protections do safety belts deliver according to collision studies?
sec05-card-sec05-F20.teaching_text: Staying pinned behind the wheel during a first swerve or bump lets you steer and brake away from a second hit.

sec05-card-sec05-F21.question_text: What does South Carolina's primary safety belt enforcement law allow an officer with a clear view to do?
sec05-card-sec05-F21.teaching_text: Officers need zero other traffic violations to initiate a stop when they clearly spot an unbelted rider or child.

sec05-card-sec05-F22.question_text: Where must the shoulder harness rest, and why should it never go under your arm or behind your back?
sec05-card-sec05-F22.teaching_text: Tucking the upper strap under an arm dumps crash force straight into fragile ribs and internal organs.

sec05-card-sec05-F23.question_text: How should the lap belt fit after clicking in, and what happens if it rides loose or high?
sec05-card-sec05-F23.teaching_text: Strong pelvic bones handle crash loads, whereas a loose belt lets your body slide underneath in a collision.

sec05-card-sec05-R06.question_text: Which body zones carry the shoulder strap versus the lap strap, and why does misplacing either matter?
sec05-card-sec05-R06.teaching_text: Both straps target sturdy skeletal structure, so routing either one wrong creates severe internal or submarine injury risk.

sec05-card-sec05-F24.question_text: Can air bags replace buckling your safety belt inside an air-bag-equipped vehicle?
sec05-card-sec05-F24.teaching_text: Skipping the belt leaves you unprotected in rollovers, rear hits, or secondary impacts after an air bag deflates.

sec05-card-sec05-F25.question_text: Why are air bags called supplemental restraints, and which body parts do they help shield?
sec05-card-sec05-F25.teaching_text: Working alongside a buckled belt, the cushion keeps your head and upper torso from slamming hard cabin surfaces.

sec05-card-sec05-F26.question_text: How do safety belts help an air bag protect you, and where do you check your vehicle's specific air bags?
sec05-card-sec05-F26.teaching_text: A fastened belt holds your torso back so you meet the cushion properly instead of catching its explosive opening.

sec05-card-sec05-F27.question_text: What installation standard applies to every child seat, and where must a rear-facing seat never sit?
sec05-card-sec05-F27.teaching_text: An inflating front cushion strikes the back of a rear-facing shell right behind an infant's head with lethal force.

sec05-card-sec05-F28.question_text: Where must children age seven and younger ride, and what hazard does that seating rule avoid?
sec05-card-sec05-F28.teaching_text: Keeping young kids secured in the rear row shields smaller frames from powerful front-row air bag deployment.

sec05-card-sec05-F29.question_text: How must a child under age two be secured, and when does the child outgrow that setup?
sec05-card-sec05-F29.teaching_text: Rear-facing shells cradle fragile infant necks until the child passes the manufacturer's height or weight cap.

sec05-card-sec05-F30.question_text: Which children belong in a forward-facing rear car seat, and how long do they stay in it?
sec05-card-sec05-F30.teaching_text: Harness straps distribute crash forces safely until the child tops out that forward-facing shell's height or weight rating.

sec05-card-sec05-R08.question_text: Is turning age two the sole trigger for moving a child from rear-facing to forward-facing?
sec05-card-sec05-R08.teaching_text: Permit distractors claim birthdays alone decide, forgetting a tall or heavy toddler who outgrows rear-facing limits earlier.

sec05-card-sec05-F31.question_text: When does a child move into a rear-row booster seat, and when can the booster finally come out?
sec05-card-sec05-F31.teaching_text: Boosters lift smaller frames so adult webbing crosses strong hip and shoulder bones instead of soft stomachs and necks.
sec05-card-sec05-F31.must_match_memory_hook: Four plus outgrown, until belt fits

visual_sync.text_span: Four plus outgrown, until belt fits

sec05-card-sec05-R09.question_text: Which vehicle belts must secure a child riding on a booster seat?
sec05-card-sec05-R09.teaching_text: Using a lap strap alone with a booster leaves the child's upper body unrestrained to whip forward on impact.

sec05-card-sec05-F32.question_text: At what age or height may a child switch to an adult safety belt if it fits properly?
sec05-card-sec05-F32.teaching_text: Reaching four feet nine inches or age eight lets standard webbing sit safely provided the fit is snug.

sec05-card-sec05-R07.question_text: How does the age-seven back-seat rule differ from the age-eight or fifty-seven-inch adult belt rule?
sec05-card-sec05-R07.teaching_text: Keeping row location separate from belt readiness stops tricky questions from tangling age seven with fifty-seven inches.

sec05-card-sec05-F33.question_text: Where online can drivers read the full South Carolina child passenger safety statute?
sec05-card-sec05-F33.teaching_text: Checking the state child-restraint site clarifies exact height and weight details whenever kids grow into a new seat.

sec05-card-sec05-F34.question_text: What criminal charge and financial costs face a driver hauling an unsecured load in South Carolina?
sec05-card-sec05-F34.teaching_text: Spilled lumber or trash causes violent swerves behind you and sticks you with both court fines and road cleanup.

sec05-card-sec05-F35.question_text: Under the manual's rule, when does cargo truly count as a secure load?
sec05-card-sec05-F35.teaching_text: Heavy items staying inside the bed is not enough if loose gravel sifts out or light debris blows airborne.

sec05-card-sec05-F36.question_text: How should you fasten cargo to a vehicle or trailer, and what should cover the top?
sec05-card-sec05-F36.teaching_text: Tying items to each other instead of anchoring straight to the frame lets the whole bundle launch during braking.

sec05-card-sec05-R10.question_text: Along with tying down cargo, what three load rules cover weight limits, pre-trip checks, and animals?
sec05-card-sec05-R10.teaching_text: Overloaded trailers sway dangerously while an unrestrained dog in a pickup bed risks falling into highway lanes.

sec05-card-sec05-R11.question_text: What four safety checks should you ask yourself before pulling out with a loaded vehicle or trailer?
sec05-card-sec05-R11.teaching_text: Picturing hard braking, rough bumps, and riding right behind your own tailgate exposes weak tie-downs before departure.

sec05-card-sec05-F37.question_text: Once vehicle driver-assistance features detect a hazard, what two ways can they respond?
sec05-card-sec05-F37.teaching_text: Knowing whether your car merely beeps or actively brakes keeps you from freezing during a sudden close call.

sec05-card-sec05-R12.question_text: What separates warning-only assistance systems from intervening assistance systems?
sec05-card-sec05-R12.teaching_text: Assuming a warning chime will hit the brakes for you invites a rear-end crash if your system only alerts.
sec05-card-sec05-R12.must_match_memory_hook: Alerts warn, interventions brake or steer

visual_sync.text_span: Alerts warn, interventions brake or steer

sec05-card-sec05-F38.question_text: Which six warning, braking, camera, parking, and lane tools does the manual list as assistance features?
sec05-card-sec05-F38.teaching_text: Recognizing each feature name helps you check which sensors your family vehicle carries before heading into traffic.

sec05-card-sec05-F39.question_text: Which two vehicle convenience or assistance features are off-limits during your skills road check?
sec05-card-sec05-F39.teaching_text: Examiners grade your own footwork, mirror judgment, and steering control rather than automated speed or parking software.

sec05-card-sec05-R13.question_text: Why is parking assist noteworthy on the road skills check despite appearing on the safety-feature list?
sec05-card-sec05-R13.teaching_text: Even helpful safety tech stays switched off when an examiner needs proof you can maneuver into spaces yourself.

sec05-card-sec05-F40.question_text: Do driver assistance systems drive the car for you, or what does the driver still owe?
sec05-card-sec05-F40.teaching_text: Treating lane assist like autopilot breeds distraction right when faded paint or sudden cut-ins demand instant human input.

sec05-card-sec05-F41.question_text: Even with cameras and sensors onboard, how must you keep track of surroundings and who stays accountable?
sec05-card-sec05-F41.teaching_text: Cameras miss fast cross-traffic angles, so skipping shoulder glances leaves you fully liable for any blind-zone hit.

sec05-card-sec05-F42.question_text: Where do you learn your safety tech's limits, and which six weather or road conditions can fool it?
sec05-card-sec05-F42.teaching_text: Storm spray, glare ice, fog, hills, and sharp curves can blind radar and lane cameras without warning.

sec05-card-sec05-R14.question_text: What two maintenance steps keep driver-assistance sensors and software working as the maker intended?
sec05-card-sec05-R14.teaching_text: Road grime over a bumper radar or outdated system software can silence collision alerts when you expect them.

sec05-card-sec05-R15.question_text: When a focused driver uses safety assistance features properly, what safety outcomes can they help lower?
sec05-card-sec05-R15.teaching_text: Pairing attentive human scanning with clean, updated sensors adds a backup layer that trims severe road casualties.

sec07-card-sec07-F01.question_text: What two practical questions do right-of-way rules settle when drivers or pedestrians meet at an intersection?
sec07-card-sec07-F01.teaching_text: Clear priority rules prevent standoffs and collisions whenever multiple paths cross at once.

sec07-card-sec07-F02.question_text: Why must you never treat the right-of-way as automatically yours entering an intersection?
sec07-card-sec07-F02.teaching_text: Insisting on technical priority when another driver misjudges an intersection leads straight into preventable crashes.

sec07-card-sec07-F03.question_text: Which three groups of road users already inside an intersection keep priority until clear?
sec07-card-sec07-F03.teaching_text: Charging ahead before walkers, riders, or turning cars finish clearing turns routine intersections into crash zones.

sec07-card-sec07-F04.question_text: What does South Carolina's First Car Rule require when another driver reaches an intersection ahead of you?
sec07-card-sec07-F04.teaching_text: Tracking arrival order settles most stop-sign intersections cleanly before any tie-breaker is needed.

sec07-card-sec07-F06.question_text: When two vehicles stop simultaneously at a four-way stop, how does South Carolina's Same Time Rule break the tie?
sec07-card-sec07-F06.teaching_text: Looking to your right breaks simultaneous four-way ties without awkward hand-waving or hesitation.

sec07-card-sec07-R01.question_text: Under what exact arrival condition does the Same Time Rule step in at a four-way stop, and who waits?
sec07-card-sec07-R01.teaching_text: Arrival order still governs staggered stops, leaving the left-yields-to-right rule strictly for dead ties.

sec07-card-sec07-F05.question_text: Before turning left across traffic, which stream of vehicles holds the right-of-way?
sec07-card-sec07-F05.teaching_text: Misjudging oncoming speed while cutting left across opposing lanes causes severe T-bone collisions.

sec07-card-sec07-F07.question_text: Whom must you yield to when pulling onto a public highway out of a driveway or private lane?
sec07-card-sec07-F07.teaching_text: Through traffic on a public road expects uninterrupted flow, so private-drive exits wait for a clean gap.

sec07-card-sec07-F08.question_text: While building speed on an interstate or limited-access entrance ramp, who holds lane priority?
sec07-card-sec07-F08.teaching_text: Mainline interstate traffic keeps priority, making the merging ramp driver responsible for blending into a gap.

sec07-card-sec07-R02.question_text: Link left-turn yielding with entering from ramps, driveways, or private roads under one priority principle?
sec07-card-sec07-R02.teaching_text: Whether crossing oncoming lanes left or joining a roadway from an access point, established traffic goes first.

sec07-card-sec07-F09.question_text: Alongside signals, signs, and painted lines, which three groups of people give enforceable traffic control directions?
sec07-card-sec07-F09.teaching_text: Human directions from police, highway workers, or school crossing guards carry full traffic-control authority.

sec07-card-sec07-F10.question_text: From top to bottom, how are the three colors stacked on a standard vertical traffic signal?
sec07-card-sec07-F10.teaching_text: Standardizing red at the top helps color-vision-deficient drivers read stop versus go by position alone.

sec07-card-sec07-F11.question_text: From left to right, how are colors arranged on a horizontal metropolitan traffic signal?
sec07-card-sec07-F11.teaching_text: Knowing red sits farthest left prevents hesitation when driving through cities that mount signals sideways.

sec07-card-sec07-R03.question_text: Must every traffic signal head carry all three colors, or do single-color signals exist?
sec07-card-sec07-R03.teaching_text: Rural crossroads and special hazards often hang a single red, yellow, or green beacon over the lane.

sec07-card-sec07-F12.question_text: Under what condition does a steady green traffic light allow you to proceed through an intersection?
sec07-card-sec07-F12.teaching_text: Green grants permission rather than a blind launch pad if stragglers or walkers still occupy the box.

sec07-card-sec07-F13.question_text: Which light precedes a steady yellow, what does yellow warn of, and what action should you take?
sec07-card-sec07-F13.teaching_text: Speeding up to beat a steady yellow invites red-light T-bones right as cross traffic launches.

sec07-card-sec07-R05.question_text: Around which sides of your car must you anticipate other drivers' mistakes when approaching a yellow signal?
sec07-card-sec07-R05.teaching_text: Checking mirrors and adjacent lanes catches rear bumpers trying to run yellow or cars slamming brakes ahead.

sec07-card-sec07-F14.question_text: If you have already entered the intersection when the signal switches to yellow, what should you do?
sec07-card-sec07-F14.teaching_text: Stopping or reversing mid-intersection strands your car directly across cross-traffic lanes when red hits.

sec07-card-sec07-F15.question_text: Where must your vehicle halt and wait at a steady red traffic light?
sec07-card-sec07-F15.teaching_text: Keeping your front bumper behind the line, crosswalk, or corner edge leaves pedestrian walkways unobstructed.

sec07-card-sec07-F16.question_text: When does South Carolina forbid turning right against a steady red signal?
sec07-card-sec07-F16.teaching_text: Scanning the signal masthead or corner post first keeps you from missing a No Turn on Red sign.

sec07-card-sec07-F17.question_text: Where must you stop for a legal right turn on red, and whom must you yield to first?
sec07-card-sec07-F17.teaching_text: Rolling past the near-side crosswalk without a full stop cuts off walkers and lawful cross traffic.

sec07-card-sec07-F18.question_text: How should you drive through an intersection controlled by a flashing yellow light?
sec07-card-sec07-F18.teaching_text: Cross traffic often faces stop signs below a flashing yellow, so easing off pace prepares for pull-outs.

sec07-card-sec07-R04.question_text: Contrast your obligation at a steady yellow traffic light against a flashing yellow light?
sec07-card-sec07-R04.teaching_text: Steady yellow signals an imminent red stop, whereas flashing yellow keeps traffic flowing slowly on alert.

sec07-card-sec07-F19.question_text: Which everyday street sign matches the exact procedure required at a flashing red traffic light?
sec07-card-sec07-F19.teaching_text: Come to a dead stop behind the line or crosswalk, scan both ways, yield, and proceed when safe.

sec07-card-sec07-R06.question_text: After coming to a full stop, how does a flashing red light differ from a steady red light?
sec07-card-sec07-R06.teaching_text: Waiting forever for a flashing red to turn green backs up traffic when stop-and-yield rules let you go.

sec07-card-sec07-F20.question_text: Which five road topics do traffic signs communicate, and what four visual cues hint at their meaning?
sec07-card-sec07-F20.teaching_text: Recognizing shape and color from afar tells you whether a sign warns, regulates, or guides before letters sharpen.

sec07-card-sec07-R07.question_text: Does the South Carolina driver's manual include every traffic sign on the road or a focused selection?
sec07-card-sec07-R07.teaching_text: Learning shape and color families lets you decode unfamiliar signs beyond the manual's highlighted examples.

sec07-card-sec07-F21.question_text: What upcoming road conditions or driver readiness do warning signs alert you to?
sec07-card-sec07-F21.teaching_text: Spotting a warning sign early gives you smooth deceleration room before hidden hazards or stops appear.

sec07-card-sec07-F22.question_text: What outline and background-plus-symbol colors identify most highway warning signs?
sec07-card-sec07-F22.teaching_text: High-contrast black symbols on a yellow diamond stand out quickly against green trees and gray pavement.

sec07-card-sec07-F23.question_text: Which three pedestrian and student areas often use extra-bright fluorescent yellow warning signs?
sec07-card-sec07-F23.teaching_text: Fluorescent yellow-green catches peripheral vision fast in dim dawn or dusk hours around walkers and kids.

sec07-card-sec07-F24.question_text: Which six curve and intersection-layout warning signs does the South Carolina manual group first?
sec07-card-sec07-F24.teaching_text: Arrow bends and junction stems tell you instantly whether the road curves or meets cross, side, T, or Y traffic.
sec07-card-sec07-F24.must_match_memory_hook: Curves plus cross, T, side, Y

visual_sync.text_span: Curves plus cross, T, side, Y

sec07-card-sec07-F25.question_text: Which six divided-highway, lane-transition, merge, and signal warning signs does the manual highlight next?
sec07-card-sec07-F25.teaching_text: Telling Divided Highway Begins apart from Ends, and Merge from Added Lane, prevents wrong-way or squeeze errors.

sec07-card-sec07-F26.question_text: Which eight wet-road, sharp-curve, advisory-speed, stop-ahead, and cyclist-or-walker signs round out the warning section?
sec07-card-sec07-F26.teaching_text: Pairing Sharp Curve diamonds with Advisory Speed plaques and crossing alerts prevents spinouts and pedestrian conflicts.

sec07-card-sec07-F27.question_text: Where is a circular yellow sign bearing an X and black RR letters placed, and what four actions follow?
sec07-card-sec07-F27.teaching_text: Standing well ahead of grade crossings, the round yellow RR sign cues slowing, looking, listening, and stop readiness.

sec07-card-sec07-F28.question_text: Where stands the white X-shaped Railroad Crossing sign, and where must you wait when a train approaches?
sec07-card-sec07-F28.teaching_text: Marked right at the rails, the white X crossbuck demands halting behind the stop line or crossing until clear.

sec07-card-sec07-R08.question_text: Contrast the roadside location of the round yellow RR sign against the white X-shaped Railroad Crossing sign?
sec07-card-sec07-R08.teaching_text: Yellow circles give advance stopping notice down the road, whereas white X crossbucks pinpoint the tracks.
sec07-card-sec07-R08.must_match_memory_hook: Yellow warns early; white marks rails

visual_sync.text_span: Yellow warns early; white marks rails

sec07-card-sec07-F29.question_text: Why do multi-track railroad crossings post a numbered track plaque, and what hidden danger does it flag?
sec07-card-sec07-F29.teaching_text: One passing caboose can hide a second locomotive charging down an adjacent set of rails.

sec07-card-sec07-R09.question_text: Can you rely on every multi-track crossing having a track-count sign, or must you verify rails yourself?
sec07-card-sec07-R09.teaching_text: Because some multi-track crossings lack numbered plaques, scanning for extra rails and second trains is always on you.

sec07-card-sec07-F30.question_text: Are flashing warning lights installed at every South Carolina railroad grade crossing?
sec07-card-sec07-F30.teaching_text: Assuming dark or absent signals mean zero trains turns rural unlit crossings into deadly traps.

sec07-card-sec07-F31.question_text: Once you check both directions and begin crossing railroad tracks, how should you move across them?
sec07-card-sec07-F31.teaching_text: Hesitating, shifting gears, or stopping mid-track leaves your vehicle exposed in a locomotive's path.

sec07-card-sec07-F32.question_text: How long must you wait after a train crosses the highway before pulling onto the tracks?
sec07-card-sec07-F32.teaching_text: Waiting until the train moves well down the line and active gates or lights clear reveals hidden parallel tracks.
sec07-card-sec07-F32.must_match_memory_hook: Until far clear and gates-lights off

visual_sync.text_span: Until far clear and gates-lights off

sec07-card-sec07-F33.question_text: Where must you halt if traffic congestion or a red signal stops cars ahead of railroad tracks?
sec07-card-sec07-F33.teaching_text: Waiting behind the stop line before the rails guarantees traffic never pins your bumper across the tracks.

sec07-card-sec07-R10.question_text: Reconcile never stopping on railroad tracks with having to stop for backed-up traffic or a red signal?
sec07-card-sec07-R10.teaching_text: All waiting happens behind the stop line beforehand so your actual roll across the steel stays continuous.

sec07-card-sec07-F34.question_text: Which posted sign gives you an emergency phone number and location details if your vehicle gets stuck on railroad tracks?
sec07-card-sec07-F34.teaching_text: Calling the blue crossing sign's emergency line with the crossing ID lets rail dispatchers halt approaching trains.

sec07-card-sec07-F35.question_text: Which two outlines and color scheme identify temporary South Carolina work-zone signs?
sec07-card-sec07-F35.teaching_text: Spotting bright orange backgrounds tells you immediately that normal roadway rules are shifting for active crews.

sec07-card-sec07-R11.question_text: Which three categories of roadway operations use orange diamond or rectangular work-zone signs?
sec07-card-sec07-R11.teaching_text: Orange alerts cover short-notice utility repairs and emergency responders right alongside major highway rebuilds.

sec07-card-sec07-F37.question_text: Which five standard orange signs warn of human traffic control, crews, lane drops, and alternate routes?
sec07-card-sec07-F37.teaching_text: Reading Flagger Ahead or One Lane Road Ahead early lets you merge smoothly and watch for stopped queues.

sec07-card-sec07-F38.question_text: What authority does a work-zone flagger holding a paddle sign or flag carry over approaching drivers?
sec07-card-sec07-F38.teaching_text: Flaggers coordinate single-lane alternating traffic and heavy equipment moves that drivers cannot see around bends.

sec07-card-sec07-F39.question_text: What dual safety role do drums, cones, and tube panels serve through an active work zone?
sec07-card-sec07-F39.teaching_text: Channelizing devices wall off open trenches and crews while steering traffic smoothly along temporary lane shifts.

sec07-card-sec07-R12.question_text: Beyond steering live lanes through construction, what dangerous areas do work-zone barriers seal off?
sec07-card-sec07-R12.teaching_text: Driving around orange barricades can put your tires onto washed-out pavement, wet concrete, or open drop-offs.

sec07-card-sec07-F40.question_text: How may a portable work-zone traffic signal be announced ahead, and where do you stop for it?
sec07-card-sec07-F40.teaching_text: Stopping behind the temporary white bar leaves room for wide trucks or opposing one-lane traffic to swing clear.

sec10-card-sec10-F01.question_text: Must you stop when meeting a stopped school bus from the opposite direction on a multi-lane highway or private road?
sec10-card-sec10-F01.teaching_text: South Carolina excuses opposite-direction drivers on qualifying multi-lane roads so children never cross four wide lanes.

sec10-card-sec10-F02.question_text: How many total lanes—and how many in each direction—define a multi-lane road under South Carolina's school bus rule?
sec10-card-sec10-F02.teaching_text: A two-lane road with a center turn stripe fails that test—you need at least two travel lanes each way.

sec10-card-sec10-F03.question_text: Does road width ever excuse you from stopping when you approach from behind a stopped school bus?
sec10-card-sec10-F03.teaching_text: Even on a six-lane divided highway, trailing vehicles share the boarding curb with children and must always halt.

sec10-card-sec10-R09.question_text: How does South Carolina school-bus stopping law contrast trailing behind a bus against meeting one head-on?
sec10-card-sec10-R09.teaching_text: Pairing universal rear stops with the four-lane oncoming carveout solves nearly every school-bus question on exam day.
sec10-card-sec10-R09.must_match_memory_hook: Behind always stops, multi-lane meets pass

visual_sync.text_span: Behind always stops, multi-lane meets pass

sec10-card-sec10-F04.question_text: After halting for a school bus, what two bus signals allow you to start moving again?
sec10-card-sec10-F04.teaching_text: Rolling early while red flashers still blink draws severe South Carolina school-bus passing penalties.

sec10-card-sec10-F05.question_text: What basic obligation toward other road users applies every single time you park your vehicle?
sec10-card-sec10-F05.teaching_text: Blocking driveways, sightlines, or walkways creates hazards and can get your vehicle ticketed or towed.

sec10-card-sec10-R08.question_text: What general location rule should guide you whenever choosing where to leave your car?
sec10-card-sec10-R08.teaching_text: Improvising a spot on grass medians, fire lanes, or unmarked shoulders invites fines and collisions.

sec10-card-sec10-F06.question_text: Who must actually be driving or riding inside a placard-equipped car to legally use a disability parking space?
sec10-card-sec10-F06.teaching_text: Borrowing a relative's placard car for a solo errand while they stay home is an illegal misuse violation.

sec10-card-sec10-F07.question_text: In South Carolina, what is the maximum number of inches your parked tires may sit from the curb or road edge?
sec10-card-sec10-F07.teaching_text: Note South Carolina's eighteen-inch allowance—wider than twelve-inch states, making eighteen a classic state test number.

sec10-card-sec10-F08.question_text: What two roadside visual cues warn you where parking is banned or time-limited?
sec10-card-sec10-F08.teaching_text: Even where no metal sign stands, colored curb paint alone legally restricts or forbids stopping there.

sec10-card-sec10-F09.question_text: What three preparation steps come first before steering into an angle or perpendicular parking stall?
sec10-card-sec10-F09.teaching_text: Blinking early in busy parking aisles stops trailing shoppers from trying to squeeze around your turning nose.

sec10-card-sec10-F10.question_text: How do you steer and position your vehicle as you pull into an angle or perpendicular space?
sec10-card-sec10-F10.teaching_text: Slow speed gives crisp steering room so both side doors open cleanly between painted stall lines.

sec10-card-sec10-R11.question_text: What three final actions complete parking inside a perpendicular or angle stall?
sec10-card-sec10-R11.teaching_text: Easing all the way to the front line keeps your rear bumper tucked safely out of the driving aisle.

sec10-card-sec10-F11.question_text: How far do you reverse straight back—and where do your eyes stay—when leaving an angle or perpendicular stall?
sec10-card-sec10-F11.teaching_text: Turning the wheel before your front bumper clears the parked neighbor scrapes their quarter panel.

sec10-card-sec10-F12.question_text: Once your front bumper clears neighboring cars while backing out, how do you turn and pull away?
sec10-card-sec10-F12.teaching_text: Coming to a full stop before shifting into drive protects your transmission and confirms a clear aisle ahead.

sec10-card-sec10-F13.question_text: What three opening steps kick off every parallel-parking maneuver?
sec10-card-sec10-F13.teaching_text: Signaling before slowing alerts trailing drivers so they stop well behind the open curb gap instead of blocking you.

sec10-card-sec10-F14.question_text: Once traffic clears for parallel parking, what gear shift and head position come next?
sec10-card-sec10-F14.teaching_text: Looking directly backward in your travel path gives true depth judgment that small mirrors distort.

sec10-card-sec10-F15.question_text: During the initial cut into a parallel stall, what bumper alignment tells you when to counter-steer?
sec10-card-sec10-F15.teaching_text: Lining your front bumper even with the lead car's rear bumper sets the exact pivot point to tuck your nose clear.

sec10-card-sec10-F16.question_text: What combination of foot speed and hand speed guides your vehicle into the center of a parallel space?
sec10-card-sec10-F16.teaching_text: Slow rolling paired with brisk steering pivots the car sharply within minimal curb length.

sec10-card-sec10-F17.question_text: How do you avoid tapping the car behind, center up, and meet South Carolina's final curb measurement?
sec10-card-sec10-F17.teaching_text: Tapping bumpers fails a road test—halt short, pull forward in drive, and settle within eighteen inches of the curb.

sec10-card-sec10-R10.question_text: Does parallel parking follow a different curb distance or the exact same limit as general roadway parking?
sec10-card-sec10-R10.teaching_text: Remembering one single eighteen-inch number covers every South Carolina curbside parking question.

sec10-card-sec10-F18.question_text: What first move creates nose clearance before pulling forward out of a tight parallel space?
sec10-card-sec10-F18.teaching_text: Backing close to the rear car opens the forward steering angle needed to clear the bumper ahead.

sec10-card-sec10-F19.question_text: After backing up inside a parallel space, what signal, vision checks, and steering steps pull you out?
sec10-card-sec10-F19.teaching_text: Mirrors miss cars closing fast beside your rear quarter panel, making that over-the-shoulder glance essential.

sec10-card-sec10-R12.question_text: What should you do while exiting a parallel stall if your front bumper looks too tight to clear the car ahead?
sec10-card-sec10-R12.teaching_text: Taking five seconds to reverse and sharpen your angle beats scraping paint forcing a tight squeeze.

sec10-card-sec10-F20.question_text: Which part of your car passing the parked car's rear bumper tells you it is clear to enter the travel lane?
sec10-card-sec10-F20.teaching_text: Waiting until your door clears their bumper ensures your entire front fender swings out cleanly without clipping.

sec10-card-sec10-R13.question_text: Who holds right-of-way—and what three checks apply—whenever you pull out of any parking space?
sec10-card-sec10-R13.teaching_text: Drivers already rolling in live lanes hold priority over every car pulling away from a curb or stall.

sec10-card-sec10-F21.question_text: Which way do you turn your front wheels when parking downhill—and what sole one-way exception flips it?
sec10-card-sec10-F21.teaching_text: On the left curb of a one-way street, turning left aims tires into that left-hand curb instead of traffic.

sec10-card-sec10-F22.question_text: Which direction do you turn your front wheels when parking headed uphill beside a raised curb?
sec10-card-sec10-F22.teaching_text: Angling wheels toward street center wedges the rear edge of your front tire solidly against the concrete curb.

sec10-card-sec10-F23.question_text: Which way must your front wheels point when parking headed uphill where no curb exists?
sec10-card-sec10-F23.teaching_text: Without raised concrete to block a roll, turning right directs a backward drift off the shoulder instead of into lanes.

sec10-card-sec10-R14.question_text: How do downhill and curbless-uphill wheel angles group together against uphill-with-curb?
sec10-card-sec10-R14.teaching_text: Memorizing uphill-with-curb as the lone street-center exception makes every hill-parking exam question effortless.

sec10-card-sec10-F24.question_text: Beyond steering angle, how do you secure brakes, transmission—including stick shifts—and ignition on every hill?
sec10-card-sec10-F24.teaching_text: Engaging park—or first or reverse gear in a manual—backs up your parking brake mechanically if cables stretch.

sec10-card-sec10-F25.question_text: How do the three quick hill-parking wheel directions line up across downhill, uphill-curb, and uphill-curbless?
sec10-card-sec10-F25.teaching_text: Every one of those three angles ensures gravity guides a brake failure away from live traffic lanes.

sec10-card-sec10-F26.question_text: Which two visual checks—and in what exact order—begin every safe lane change?
sec10-card-sec10-F26.teaching_text: Glancing at mirrors first keeps forward awareness before a quick head turn clears your side blind zone.

sec10-card-sec10-F27.question_text: After checking mirrors and blind spots, what five steps move you smoothly into the new lane?
sec10-card-sec10-F27.teaching_text: Looking a second time after signaling catches fast drivers who closed into your gap while your blinker clicked.

sec10-card-sec10-F28.question_text: How should you use a highway acceleration lane before merging onto main travel lanes?
sec10-card-sec10-F28.teaching_text: Pulling onto a seventy-mile-per-hour interstate at forty forces trucks to slam brakes or swerve dangerously.

sec10-card-sec10-F29.question_text: Once you match speed on the acceleration lane, what three actions finish a clean highway merge?
sec10-card-sec10-F29.teaching_text: Ramp merges rarely turn the steering wheel sharp enough to auto-cancel your blinker, so flick it off manually.

sec10-card-sec10-F30.question_text: How early should you move into the lane nearest your highway exit—and what mistake does that prevent?
sec10-card-sec10-F30.teaching_text: Last-second multi-lane dives across exit gore stripes cause high-speed rollovers and sideswipes.

sec10-card-sec10-F31.question_text: Where do you hold highway pace, and when do you finally brake toward the ramp advisory speed?
sec10-card-sec10-F31.teaching_text: Braking early on live interstate pavement triggers rear-end chain collisions behind you.

sec10-card-sec10-R15.question_text: Where does a highway deceleration lane sit, and how does your speed split before versus inside it?
sec10-card-sec10-R15.teaching_text: Treating the right-side auxiliary strip as your dedicated braking runway keeps main freeway flow smooth.

sec10-card-sec10-F32.question_text: On a road with multiple lanes going your way, which lane is designated for overtaking slower traffic?
sec10-card-sec10-F32.teaching_text: Keeping passing predictable on the far left prevents chaotic weaving across slower right lanes.

sec10-card-sec10-R16.question_text: How do the legal roles of the left-most lane and the right-hand shoulder contrast on multi-lane highways?
sec10-card-sec10-R16.teaching_text: Shoulders shelter breakdowns and responders—using them to jump traffic queues risks lethal roadside strikes.

sec10-card-sec10-F33.question_text: May you ever use a wide paved right shoulder to pass another vehicle in South Carolina?
sec10-card-sec10-F33.teaching_text: Paved or unpaved, the right shoulder is strictly an emergency stopping lane rather than a travel lane.

sec10-card-sec10-F34.question_text: Why does the manual urge completing every legal pass briskly rather than lingering beside another car?
sec10-card-sec10-F34.teaching_text: Hovering next to another vehicle's rear quarter panel leaves you invisible if they drift toward your lane.

sec10-card-sec10-F35.question_text: What three traffic zones—ahead and behind—must you verify before pulling out to pass?
sec10-card-sec10-F35.teaching_text: Swinging left without checking your own blind spot cuts straight into a faster car already overtaking you.

sec10-card-sec10-F36.question_text: At least how many feet ahead must your turn signal flash before pulling out to pass?
sec10-card-sec10-F36.teaching_text: One hundred feet matches South Carolina's standard turn-and-lane-change blinker law, making it easy to remember.

sec10-card-sec10-F37.question_text: What sight in your rearview mirror—plus signal and head check—clears you to return right after passing?
sec10-card-sec10-F37.teaching_text: Cutting back before both headlights show in your inside mirror clips their front bumper at highway speed.

sec10-card-sec10-R17.question_text: How do the responsibilities of the overtaking driver and the overtaken driver fit together during a pass?
sec10-card-sec10-R17.teaching_text: Steady speed from the right-lane car lets the passer reach mirror clearance quickly without getting trapped.

sec10-card-sec10-F38.question_text: What lane, speed, and alertness habits apply whenever another driver is passing your vehicle?
sec10-card-sec10-F38.teaching_text: Speeding up out of pride extends their exposure in oncoming lanes and raises crash danger for both cars.
sec10-card-sec10-F38.must_match_memory_hook: Hold lane, steady speed, stay alert

visual_sync.text_span: Hold lane, steady speed, stay alert

sec10-card-sec10-F39.question_text: Which six traffic, sightline, junction, rail, or bridge situations forbid trying to pass?
sec10-card-sec10-F39.teaching_text: Blind crests, cross-traffic corners, railroad tracks, and narrow bridge decks leave zero escape room.
sec10-card-sec10-F39.must_match_memory_hook: Oncoming, curves, hills, junctions, rails, bridges

visual_sync.text_span: Oncoming, curves, hills, junctions, rails, bridges

sec10-card-sec10-F40.question_text: What three adjustments should you make whenever overtaking a bicyclist?
sec10-card-sec10-F40.teaching_text: Generous side clearance buffers cyclists against wind blast from your car and sudden pavement potholes.
sec10-card-sec10-F40.must_match_memory_hook: Ease off, wide berth, judge pace

visual_sync.text_span: Ease off, wide berth, judge pace

sec10-card-sec10-R01.question_text: What other name does the zipper merge go by, and how do drivers execute it?
sec10-card-sec10-R01.teaching_text: Using both lanes all the way to the taper and alternating one-for-one keeps traffic flowing smoothly.

sec10-card-sec10-R02.question_text: What three hazards prompted South Carolina's manual to favor zipper merging over early merging?
sec10-card-sec10-R02.teaching_text: Leaving one lane empty for a mile tempts impatient queue-jumpers and blockers into dangerous road-rage clashes.

sec10-card-sec10-R03.question_text: Once a lane-closed warning appears and traffic slows down, how should you handle your lane?
sec10-card-sec10-R03.teaching_text: Holding your current lane right to the cones uses full pavement capacity before smoothly alternating.

sec10-card-sec10-R04.question_text: Is the zipper merge mandated by South Carolina statute or recommended as a best practice?
sec10-card-sec10-R04.teaching_text: Exams test this exact distinction—no statute forces late merging, yet construction zones rely on it as best practice.

sec10-card-sec10-R05.question_text: How does zipper merging affect lane speed differences, and by up to what percentage can it shrink backups?
sec10-card-sec10-R05.teaching_text: Matching speeds side by side makes merging effortless while shrinking queue length by up to forty percent.

sec10-card-sec10-R06.question_text: Beyond shorter backups, what three traffic and mood benefits come from everyone using the zipper merge?
sec10-card-sec10-R06.teaching_text: When both lanes creep forward at identical speed, nobody feels cheated and road rage drops sharply.

sec10-card-sec10-R07.question_text: Under what traffic condition does moving over early beat waiting for a zipper merge?
sec10-card-sec10-R07.teaching_text: At open freeway speeds with plenty of room, sliding into the open lane early avoids high-speed cone surprises.

sec12-card-sec12-F01.question_text: What overriding safety duty rests on every driver regardless of who started a mistake?
sec12-card-sec12-F01.teaching_text: Having technical right-of-way never excuses skipping a safe brake or swerve that could prevent a wreck.

sec12-card-sec12-R01.question_text: Why should every driver rehearse emergency responses before trouble ever strikes?
sec12-card-sec12-R01.teaching_text: Almost everyone faces a sudden hazard eventually, and pre-learned muscle memory beats freezing in panic.

sec12-card-sec12-F02.question_text: What are your exact three vehicle-control options to avoid a crash or soften its impact?
sec12-card-sec12-F02.teaching_text: Knowing all three options stops you from fixating strictly on brakes when an open lane or throttle saves you.

sec12-card-sec12-R02.question_text: Which of the three evasion moves is almost every driver's automatic first instinct?
sec12-card-sec12-R02.teaching_text: Because slamming brakes comes naturally, smart drivers consciously train their eyes to spot steering escape lanes too.

sec12-card-sec12-F03.question_text: What two advantages does an anti-lock braking system give you during a hard emergency stop?
sec12-card-sec12-F03.teaching_text: Keeping front tires rolling instead of locked lets you steer around the obstacle while slowing hard.

sec12-card-sec12-F04.question_text: How must your foot press an anti-lock brake pedal in an emergency—and why must you never pump it?
sec12-card-sec12-F04.teaching_text: Pumping the brake pedal switches off computer-controlled pulsing and wastes precious stopping distance.

sec12-card-sec12-R03.question_text: How does proper anti-lock braking technique contrast directly against old-school pedal pumping?
sec12-card-sec12-R03.teaching_text: Lifting off to pump shuts anti-lock modulation down right when computer valves are cycling fastest.

sec12-card-sec12-F05.question_text: What pedal feel and sound are completely normal while anti-lock brakes are actively working?
sec12-card-sec12-F05.teaching_text: Startled drivers sometimes lift off a buzzing pedal thinking brakes broke—keep stomping firmly through the chatter.

sec12-card-sec12-F06.question_text: Can you steer around a hazard while holding full emergency pressure on anti-lock brakes?
sec12-card-sec12-F06.teaching_text: Stomp-hold-and-steer is the exact life-saving combo anti-lock brakes were engineered to deliver.

sec12-card-sec12-R04.question_text: Where should you check the proper emergency-braking method if driving an older vehicle without anti-lock brakes?
sec12-card-sec12-R04.teaching_text: Knowing before a trip whether your car has anti-lock brakes ensures you use the right footwork under stress.
